# prime-divider

prime-rs: Divider component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/divider) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-divider) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/divider.md)

Divider - port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-divider`.

Markup, classes, `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation`, the inline alignment style and `data-p` match PrimeNG;
instead of the `<p-divider>` host element a `<div class="p-divider ...">` with a `p-divider-content` block inside is rendered.

Properties are `Prop`/`OptProp`; if all of them are static, the component renders ready-made values without closures and `RenderEffect`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_divider::{Divider, DividerAlign, DividerType};

let html = view! { <Divider align=DividerAlign::Right divider_type=DividerType::Dashed>"OR"</Divider> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-divider-right") && html.contains("p-divider-dashed") && html.contains("justify-content: flex-end"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-divider = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["divider"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
